correctness.rationale: The search starts at the exact ternary prefix \(\mathtt{0121012}\) and exhausts all three one-letter extensions of every survivor. A power violation persists under extension, while palindromic defect cannot decrease to zero after a non-rich binary prefix because appending one letter creates at most one new distinct palindrome. Thus pruning is complete. Direct palindrome-set counting and the unioccurrent-longest-palindromic-suffix criterion give identical levels. The final counts are \(11,6,3,0\) at ternary lengths \(47,48,49,50\), and exact least-period scans verify all three images are \(\frac{14}{5}\)-free.
